children: E Point Zero, a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi's Two Point Zero Group, has acquired a 90% stake in Azura Power Holding, a London-based power producer with an active development pipeline of more than 1.5 gigawatts of gas, renewable and BESS projects across Africa.
Financial details of the transaction have not been disclosed.
E Point Zero invests in specialised energy infrastructure, including power generation and energy storage assets.

Azura Power currently operates 752 megawatts of operational capacity across three assets: Azura-Edo (461 MW, Nigeria), Tobene (116 MW, Senegal) and CTRG (175 MW, Mozambique), located in three of Africa’s largest natural gas reserve markets. The assets are underpinned by long-term power purchase agreements.
The acquisition is subject to necessary approvals from the relevant regulatory authorities.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Abu Dhabi's E Point Zero acquires 90% stake in Azura Power
